tldr: the Sun through the 4th house brings attention to home, family, privacy, and emotional foundations.
body:
When the Sun moves through your 4th house, it brings attention to home, family, privacy, memory, living space, roots, and what is happening behind closed doors. You may notice what is happening privately, what your home needs, or what old family and memory patterns are bringing into the present.

Something may feel more visible, energizing, exposed, or ready to be claimed. It can help you notice what needs more life, honesty, or direct attention.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for tending to the base of your life instead of only managing what other people can see.

The caution: Watch for needing validation so badly that you miss what actually feels true. The risk is retreating so far inward that nothing gets named or handled.

The Sun moves through this house for about a month. Use the visibility well. Put attention where it gives you more life, not just more approval.
